title: Theo and the Portrait
author: E. M. Vasquez
blurb: Emrys Thackeray, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
